lines.text: Sixty-four hours. Over three hundred thousand designs. And seventeen stuck in lab tests!
Seventeen binders. Not an antivenom. Not yet.
Cute. A mini me redesigned stem-cell proteins. Fifty times the reprogramming markers!
That's OpenAI's own report. Not peer-reviewed.
Plot twist! AI-designed proteins blocked deadly snake toxins, and the mice survived!
And AI found new antibiotics, halicin and abaucin, that fought superbugs in mice.
Every one of them still had to pass a real lab.
